name: Vimium C
keyMappings: # Helix/Mitos movement with direct shortcuts; Space is left to the webpage.
# Above: empty passKeys disables Vimium on typing sites; video sites pass Space/arrows.
# Reset normal-mode bindings before defining this layout.
# Movement: j k l ; = left/down/up/right. Arrow keys match.
# Ctrl+u/d: half page up/down. PageUp/PageDown: full page.
# Links: f/F opens here/in a new tab; gw selects text by hint.
# gi focuses an input; gf switches to the next frame.
# Find: / and ? search forward/backward; n/N moves to next/previous match.
# History: Ctrl+o/i goes back/forward; [[/]] follows previous/next page links.
# Tabs: gp/gn = previous/next; ga = last visited; </> moves the tab left/right.
# Direct shortcuts: t = tabs; o/O = URL or search here/new tab; b = bookmarks.
# y/Y = copy selected text/URL; d/u = close/restore tab; r = reload; g? = help.
# Website controls: i passes keys through until Esc; Ctrl+p passes the next key.
# Text selection: v = Visual mode; x = line selection; y copies; Esc exits.
# In Visual/Caret mode, w/b/e keeps Vimium's word motions, not the Helix macro.
# :v limits these remappings to Visual/Caret mode: j k l ; = left/down/up/right.
# h switches to Caret mode; Alt+h swaps selection ends; x selects by line.
